name: Galaxy Note 3

images.credit: GadgetsGuy, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android (operating system), Android Android Jelly Bean, 4.3 "Jelly Bean", Current: Android Lollipop, Android 5.0 "Lollipop" with TouchWiz, Unofficial: LineageOS 21.0 (Android 14)
Platform.Chipset: Samsung Exynos 5 Octa 5420 (HSPA+ version), Qualcomm Snapdragon 800 (LTE & China version)
Platform.CPU: Octa-core 1.9 GHz Cortex-A15 and 1.3 GHz Cortex-A7 (HSPA+ version), 2.3 GHz quad-core Snapdragon 800 (LTE & China version)
Platform.GPU: ARM Mali T628MP6 GPU (HSPA+ version), Adreno 330 (LTE & China version)

Display.Display: 5.7 in Full HD Super AMOLED 388 ppi (1920×1080) (PenTile matrix) (16:9 aspect ratio) with Gorilla Glass 3

Cameras.Rear camera: 13-megapixel, 2.2, with autofocus, BSI, 1080p and 4K (2160p) video recording (Sony Exmor IMX135)
